schema:
author(AuthorID INT PK, AuthorName VARCHAR(50) ['Humayun Ahmed', 'George Orwell', 'Haruki Murakami', 'Zadie Smith'], Country VARCHAR(30) ['Bangladesh', 'UK', 'Japan'])
book(BookID INT PK, Title VARCHAR(80) ['Deyal', ...], Genre VARCHAR(20) ['Fiction', 'Satire', 'Humor', 'Nonfiction'], Price DECIMAL(8,2), PublishedYear INT, AuthorID INT -> author.AuthorID)
loan(LoanID INT PK, BookID INT -> book.BookID, MemberID INT -> member.MemberID, LoanDate DATE, ReturnDate DATE)
member(MemberID INT PK, Name VARCHAR(50) ['Arif', 'Bina', 'Chandan', 'Dipa'], MemberType VARCHAR(20) ['Student', 'Teacher', 'Guest'], City VARCHAR(30) ['Dhaka', 'Khulna', 'Sylhet'])

answers.question: List the title and price of all books priced between 300 and 600, cheapest first.
answers.sql:
SELECT Title, Price
FROM book
WHERE Price BETWEEN 300 AND 600
ORDER BY Price ASC;

answers.question: Show each genre with the number of books (aliased as Book_Count) and average price (aliased as Avg_Price). Keep only genres with at least 2 books.
answers.sql:
SELECT Genre, COUNT(*) AS Book_Count, AVG(Price) AS Avg_Price
FROM book
GROUP BY Genre
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

answers.question: Display the member name and the title of each book that has not been returned yet.
answers.sql:
SELECT m.Name, b.Title
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN loan l ON m.MemberID = l.MemberID
LEFT JOIN book b ON l.BookID = b.BookID
WHERE l.ReturnDate IS NULL;

answers.question: Find authors who have no books in the library. Show AuthorName.
Show the most expensive book: title and price.
answers.sql:
SELECT b.Title, b.Price
FROM book b
ORDER BY b.Price DESC
LIMIT 1;

answers.question: Using a LEFT JOIN, show every member's Name and how many loans they made (aliased as Total_Loans).
answers.sql:
SELECT m.Name, COUNT(l.LoanID) AS Total_Loans
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN loan l ON m.MemberID = l.MemberID
GROUP BY m.MemberID;

answers.question: Show the titles of books borrowed by 'Student' type members.
answers.sql:
SELECT b.Title
FROM book b
JOIN loan l ON b.BookID = l.BookID
JOIN member m ON l.MemberID = m.MemberID
WHERE m.MemberType = 'Student';

Show the names of members who borrowed more than one book.
answers.sql:
SELECT m.Name
FROM member m
JOIN loan l ON m.MemberID = l.MemberID
GROUP BY m.MemberID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.BookID) > 1;

answers.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_title ON book(Title);
